title: Remote staff control wire protocol v1
description: JSON text messages over WSS (ARCHITECTURE.md v0.6 §4). Receivers validate against their inbound direction in $defs; the root accepts a message valid in any direction. Binary frames are described in v1.md; their JSON header is $defs/frame_header.

envelope_id.description: Request/reply correlation only. Never a command or dedup key.

command_id.description: Chosen by the desktop, unique per attachment. Dedup key is (attachment_id, command_id).

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the DER SPKI, 32 uppercase hex pairs.

unit.description: Finite coordinate relative to the content-rect crop.

frame_header.description: JSON header of a binary frame (v1.md). Not a JSON text message.

staff_to_relay.description: Every JSON text message valid in the staff to relay direction.

relay_to_staff.description: Every JSON text message valid in the relay to staff direction.

relay_to_device.description: Every JSON text message valid in the relay to device direction.

sig.description: DER SHA256withECDSA signature, base64url without padding.

device_to_relay.description: Every JSON text message valid in the device to relay direction.
